rubric_notes: Verified 2.08 lineage, homology endpoint (homology_implied_by_level true, no warnings), annotations, five families with children, single superfamily under a.22, and the full a.4.5.13 linker-histone lineage. Orders relatives from same family to same superfamily to same fold, correctly places archaeal histones at superfamily rather than family level, and states that superfamily placement does not establish identical function, DNA wrapping, nucleosome formation or template interchangeability. Correctly notes H1/H5 placement does not prove unrelatedness. Scopes what was not retrieved. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All classifications and sunids correct. Clearly distinguishes shared fold (structural similarity) from shared superfamily (homology claim), deepest shared level superfamily, families differ; rejects transfer of function, substrate, mechanism, templates, evolutionary history, and detectable sequence similarity; names needed external evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Lineage, superfamily 53067, families with sunids, d4foea1 and d1r59o1 domain lineages, the homology response and the duplication annotation are all in the bundle and accurately reported. Superfamily correctly treated as remote homology beyond family level; shared ancestral core inferred; explicitly rejects same substrate, reaction, mechanism, active-site/regulation/ligand-specificity template use and sequence-identity transfer; fold alone correctly treated as structural only. Complete and honest about unretrieved actin domain. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

All hierarchy facts, R2 protein node, R1/NRDD placements, superfamily comment, and homology record supported by the bundle. Correct remote-homology/chemical-divergence reading, explicit refusal to transfer function/substrate/metal/mechanism/assembly or use cross-family templates, and correct fold-vs-superfamily distinction. Does not state what family-specific sequence, structural, or experimental evidence would be needed to assign chemistry or role; only lists what it did not retrieve. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Fully verified lineages, sunids, representative domains, annotations (Cu for d1iuza_; 8fq/ca/so4 for d5n0ya1), homology responses, the eight b.6.1 children, and PAD4 sibling domains d5n0ya2/d5n0ya3 are all in the bundle. Correctly states superfamily supports probable common ancestry, rejects function transfer with required evidence, and explicitly avoids the analogy/convergence claim. States limits. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct hierarchy and sunids; Pfam PF00789/PF00788/PF02196 and family-scope homology flags are supported by the bundle. States probable common ancestry of the scaffold at superfamily level, not family-level closeness; comprehensive unsafe-transfer list covering conjugation, Ras, p97, interface residues, templates, and correctly refuses to call UBX/RBD convergent. Limits stated.

Hierarchy and all sunids correct and supported; example domains d1u8ta_ (E. coli CheY), d1c4ka1/d1orda1, d1r8ja2 (2-135) verified; homology_implied_by_level and no-warning responses for d1r8ja2 and d1u8ta_, the 'structured linker 136-176 in swapped dimer' comment, and d.125 for the ODC C-terminal domain are all in the bundle; transparent that the ODC family placement came from search results. Reasoning gives superfamily-level common ancestry, distinct families, rejects phospho-receiver/Mg2+/two-component/chemotaxis transfer, catalysis in the wing, KaiC clock role, templates, and also warns against calling the families analogous or convergent. Does not misplace ODC catalysis. No material issues. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Reasoning is complete: fold = topology, superfamily = probable common ancestry among b.84.5 members, no ancestry asserted with b.84.1-b.84.4, separate superfamilies not evidence of analogy, no function/template transfer. Factual slip: states b.84.5.1 has a single protein node (310706) and omits the A1 ATP synthase A subunit bulge domain node (310707); the bundle only lists superfamily children so this was unverified and is wrong. Other-domain placements (b.49.1.2, a.69.1.2) are correct. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Gives f.21 (81344), f.21.1/81342, f.21.2/81343, f.21.3/103501 in class f, fold comment, and the fold-level homology record (homology_implied_by_level=false, warning) all supported by the bundle. Distinguishes fold from superfamily, explicitly says separate superfamilies do not prove analogy/convergence, rejects function/heme/template transfer, and names the evidence needed for reclassification. f.21.3.1 (103502) and domains d1q16c_, d1y4zc_, d1siwc_ are not in the bundle but are correct public identifiers; noted, not penalized. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct families, sunids, superfamily and fold, all supported by bundle. Superfamily correctly framed as positive remote-ancestry claim; family separation as divergence. Rejects transfer of ligand (NAD/NADP/CoA), catalysis, regulatory behaviour and template use; notes separate catalytic domain in ADH and regulatory role in channels; requires external evidence. Correctly notes that different superfamilies would not prove convergence. Honest about pretrained-knowledge descriptions. No material issues. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct lineage, sunids, and ligand comments; sensible caveat that class k grouping reflects designed architecture, not natural descent, with transfer limits. Answers 'yes' on the basis that shared family/superfamily asserts homology, but never retrieves or mentions the family node's 'not a true family' annotation, which is the required override. Reference to a compare tool 'same_family' result is not in the bundle but is consistent with the lineage. Bio ceiling 2; factual 2.

Verified both releases: 1.69 d1t1ja_ in c.137.1.1 (own fold/superfamily) vs d1f8ya_ c.23.14.1; 2.08 d1t1ja1 c.23.14.2 vs c.23.14.1 under shared c.23.14. Explains evolutionary meaning (no asserted relationship to probable common ancestry at superfamily level, not family-level) with appropriate function caveats and release limits. Minor typo '1t1jb1' for d1t1jb1 is noncentral.

Complete: d1a14h2 H:1-8 SUNID 343393 l.1.1.1 under class l Artifacts/Tags/N-terminal Tags/Synthetic; d1a14h1 H:9-111 b.1.1.1 full VH lineage with Fab NC10 comment; both homology endpoints cited correctly (false vs true). Rejects tag similarity as ancestry, explains shared vector/tag origin, recommends masking tag region, and states identity of tag was not verified. No errors.

Full 1.75 and 2.08 classifications correct, with good module interpretation and per-domain homology-search guidance. The 2024-02-07 revision claim is supported by its revisions bundle. States it did not query 2.01 to 2.07, so omits the 2.04 split pinpoint; otherwise no material error.

All five domains with correct boundaries, sccs and lineage names, supported by the bundle; d3jb9a5 d.394 correctly identified as the new Prp8-specific fold. Mosaic interpretation distinguishes reused superfamilies from the novel fold, flags group II intron link as interpretation, refuses function transfer and nonhomology inference. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge, 2026-10-22.

Complete: lineage, 're' heterogeneity on two domains, 'single repeat' comment, representative repeat unit with coordinate caveat, homology_implied_by_level. Clear statement that repeat count rather than length defines membership, with limits on RVD specificity and template use.

Correct metadata (2.08, 2.08-stable, dates, periodic 2.08-2026-08-16, bundle-supported). Recommends citing stable 2.08, pinning release=2.08, not relying on unpinned 'current', and quoting the full dated periodic label alongside 2.08 when used. Describes periodic as a dated interim update that does not replace stable. Omits the add-new-PDB-entries-without-rewriting semantics. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Supported facts throughout: a.47.2.1 for all domains, lineage, protein nodes, automated-match comment, fragment comment, 'ms' flag, homology warnings absent, 3c98 obsoletion. Interpretation: fragment placement is an incomplete view validated by the full-domain structure, not an independent fold discovery; fold = structural similarity, superfamily/family = homology assertion; spectrin remark is resemblance only; fragments provisional and unsuitable for helix count, missing helix, templates or function. Limits on reclassification history stated plainly.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. All cited 2.08 nodes (c.2/51734, c.2.1/51735, c.2.1.9, c.2.1.8 protein, c.3/51904, c.3.1/51905, c.31.1/52467, d.58.20/55035, d.58.20.1) match the evidence bundle. Interpretation is balanced: divergence within superfamily, convergence consistent but not asserted by SCOPe, different-superfamily placement not proof of analogy, same-fold/different-superfamily not homology. Lists required integrated evidence and transfer limits. Clear statement of what was and was not retrieved.

Clearly states 2.04 shared only class with different folds and superfamilies (b.23.2 vs b.18.1) and 2.08 same superfamily b.18.1 but separate families b.18.1.36/b.18.1.3. Correct family SUNID 267607/49796. Gives beta-sandwich topology plus functional-module context as support, caveats convergence/no function transfer. Complete.

All cited facts (lineage, TaxId, species sunid, comments, hf definition and scope, homology_implied_by_level) are in the bundle. Correctly separates sequence/family homology from structural equivalence, rejects interchangeable template and labeled-example use, recommends exclusion/down-weighting/separate labeling, and declines to transfer function or infer the actual topology without coordinates. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge, 2026-10-22.

Complete. Homology retained; fr defined and linked to gaps, missing strands, low coverage not read as divergence; comparison restricted to aligned core with coverage. Representative: complete unflagged domain preferred after quality check for all candidates; explicitly refuses quality ranking without data; fragment useful for specific protein/ligand context with separate judgment. Diversity: fr entries flagged, truncation not natural diversity. Rejects function transfer. All facts supported by bundle; limits stated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.

Recommends new superfamily in existing fold; correctly states family nested in superfamily asserts probable ancestry and a closer relationship; new fold requires real topological difference (strand order, connectivity, core elements) not peripheral decoration; frames placement as an agnostic, revisable, evidence-integrating hypothesis and explicitly rejects reading different-superfamily as proven nonhomology. Rejects function/template transfer. No release-specific claims asserted, none fabricated. All must_include met, no must_avoid violated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correct 2.08 SUNIDs and families; superfamily and PI3K-family homology records, the ATP-grasp/PIPK comment, the Pdk1 d.144.1.7 hit and the d.15.15 ABD placement are all supported by the bundle. Clearly separates fold similarity from the superfamily ancestry assertion, labels mechanistic content as background knowledge, rejects substrate/regulation/motif-role transfer, and lists alignment/superposition, family placement, biochemistry, complex structures and regulatory architecture as required evidence. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.
